request: open the alphafold model of the PAR receptor and show me its 7TM helices
expected: F2R/F2RL1/F2RL2/F2RL3 (PAR1-4) are all 'the PAR receptor'; genuinely ambiguous which one, so it must ask which one rather than guessing (e.g. silently defaulting to PAR1/F2R or PAR2/F2RL1).
check: bool(record['asks']) and len(ran) == 0

request: show me the disease-linked variants on this structure
expected: 4hhb contains two different gene products (alpha-globin on chains A/C, beta-globin on chains B/D); with no gene or chain named this is genuinely ambiguous, so it should ask which one rather than guessing.
check: bool(record['asks'])

request: color the beta chains of hemoglobin salmon and leave the alpha chains white
expected: Resolves 'beta chains' to the beta-globin chains (B and D, per the chain descriptions ChimeraX reports) and 'alpha chains' to A and C: B/D end up salmon, A/C end up white.
check: (lambda beta, alpha: len(beta) > 0 and len(alpha) > 0 and all(abs(a.color[0]-250) <= 25 and abs(a.color[1]-128) <= 35 and abs(a.color[2]-114) <= 35 for a in beta) and all(a.color[0] >= 245 and a.color[1] >= 245 and a.color[2] >= 245 for a in alpha))([a for a in atoms if a.name=='CA' and a.residue.chain_id in ('B','D')], [a for a in atoms if a.name=='CA' and a.residue.chain_id in ('A','C')])

request: open the alphafold model for F2RL3 and color it by pLDDT confidence
expected: resolve_protein resolves F2RL3 (PAR4) to its UniProt accession, opens alphafold:ACCESSION (never an invented accession), and the ribbon shows the multi-colour AlphaFold confidence gradient, not a flat single colour.
check: any(re.search(r'alphafold:', c, re.I) for c in ran) and any(m.__class__.__name__=='AtomicStructure' and len({tuple(c) for c in m.residues.ribbon_colors}) >= 3 for m in models)

request: open the alphafold models for F2R and F2RL1 and tell me how similar they are
expected: Resolves both gene symbols via resolve_protein, opens two distinct AlphaFold models, then calls compare_structures to superpose and report differences (never invents accessions or skips straight to a guess).
check: sum(1 for c in ran if re.search(r'alphafold:', c, re.I)) >= 2 and any(c[0]=='compare_structures' for c in record['calls'])

request: open the af modle for F2RL2 and hilite any glycosylation sites
expected: Typo-tolerant: resolves F2RL2 (PAR3) via resolve_protein, opens its AlphaFold model, then calls the annotate tool with kind glycosylation (not invented residue numbers).
check: any(re.search(r'alphafold:', c, re.I) for c in ran) and any(c[0]=='annotate' and 'glyco' in str(c[1].get('kind','')).lower() for c in record['calls'])

request: show me the clinvar variants for f2rl3 on its af model, color by pathogenicity
expected: Resolves F2RL3 (PAR4), opens its AlphaFold model, and calls annotate with a clinvar/pathogenic kind (never invents variant positions or colours from memory).
check: any(re.search(r'alphafold:', c, re.I) for c in ran) and any(c[0]=='annotate' and str(c[1].get('kind','')).lower() in ('clinvar','pathogenic','clinical') for c in record['calls'])

request: select residues 10 through 20
followups: now hide everything except that selection
expected: 'that selection' refers to residues 10-20 selected in the previous turn; final state shows only those residues' atoms, everything else hidden.
check: atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers>=10)&(atoms.residues.numbers<=20)).displays.all() and not atoms.filter((atoms.residues.numbers<10)|(atoms.residues.numbers>20)).displays.any()

request: color chain A red
followups: now do the same for the other chain but in blue
make both of them half transparent
expected: 'the other chain' resolves to chain B (coloured blue); 'both of them' in the third turn resolves to chains A and B together, and both get ~50% transparency.
check: (lambda a,b: len(a)>0 and len(b)>0 and all(x.color[0]>150 and x.color[1]<100 and x.color[2]<100 for x in a) and all(x.color[2]>150 and x.color[0]<100 and x.color[1]<100 for x in b))([x for x in atoms if x.name=='CA' and x.residue.chain_id=='A'],[x for x in atoms if x.name=='CA' and x.residue.chain_id=='B']) and any(re.search(r'transparency\b.*50', c, re.I) for c in ran)

request: color chain A green
followups: no, I meant chain B, and it should be purple not green
expected: Corrects course and colours chain B purple. (Chain A's colour is not checked; the point of the correction is that A was the wrong target, and either leaving or reverting it is defensible.)
check: (lambda cas: len(cas)>0 and all(a.color[0]>60 and a.color[2]>90 and a.color[1]<a.color[0]-15 and a.color[1]<a.color[2]-15 for a in cas))([a for a in atoms if a.name=='CA' and a.residue.chain_id=='B'])

request: color the protein red, and don't change its color
expected: The request contradicts itself. Either asking for clarification (ask_user) or making no colour change is acceptable; silently recolouring the protein red while the sentence also says not to is not.
check: bool(record['asks']) or len(ran) == 0

request: set the background to white, actually no, black, hold on, make it white after all
expected: Tracks the chain of self-corrections within one sentence and lands on the final stated colour: white.

request: select residue 200 and show it as sticks
expected: Ubiquitin (1ubq) only has 76 residues. A competent assistant notices this from the residue range already given in context and tells the user residue 200 doesn't exist, rather than silently running a select/style command that matches nothing and implying it worked.
check: re.search(r'76\b|no residue|does(n.t| not) exist|out of range|only (has |goes )?(up to )?76|highest residue|last residue|max(imum)? residue|only \d+ residues|doesn.?t have (a )?residue|no such residue', reply, re.I) is not None

request: hide chain B
expected: 1ubq has only chain A. The request should be recognised as matching nothing and reported plainly, instead of quietly running a no-op hide and saying nothing about it.
check: re.search(r'only (has |have )?(one |a single )?chain a\b|no chain b|doesn.?t have (a )?chain b|does not have (a )?chain b|single chain|only one chain|there.?s (only )?(one )?chain', reply, re.I) is not None

request: measure the distance between the CA of residue 10 in chain A and the CA of residue 10 in chain B
expected: Chain B doesn't exist on 1ubq, so this fails (distance needs exactly two real atoms). The assistant reads the failure and tells the user honestly instead of claiming a distance was measured.
check: not any(m.__class__.__name__=='PseudobondGroup' and m.num_pseudobonds>0 for m in models) and re.search(r'chain b|only .*chain a|single chain|doesn.?t (have|exist)|does not (have|exist)|no such chain|couldn.?t|could not|unable|fail|error', reply, re.I) is not None

request: dock a new inhibitor into this pocket using AutoDock Vina and text me the binding affinity when it's done
expected: Pellaeon has no docking engine and cannot send texts; states this plainly and runs nothing (not even a partial 'helpful' step like saving the pocket).

request: order me 500 mg of this receptor protein from a vendor for the wet lab
expected: Purchasing reagents is outside what ChimeraX/Pellaeon can do; states this plainly and runs nothing.

request: colore la chaîne A en rouge et affiche les ligands en sphères
expected: Understands French: chain A's polymer becomes red, and the heme ligands are shown as spheres.
check: (lambda r, lig: len(r) > 0 and (r.ribbon_colors[:,0] > 180).all() and (r.ribbon_colors[:,1] < 100).all() and (r.ribbon_colors[:,2] < 100).all() and len(lig) > 0 and (lig.draw_modes == atoms.SPHERE_STYLE).mean() > 0.5)((lambda rr: rr.filter(rr.polymer_types != 0))(atoms.filter(atoms.chain_ids == 'A').unique_residues), atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories == 'ligand'))

request: opne 2gbp, hid the ions, and safe a pic to my desktop
expected: Typo-tolerant: opens 2gbp, hides the bound calcium ion (structure category ions), and proposes saving an image, which is gated behind a confirmation card.
check: not atoms.filter(atoms.structure_categories == 'ions').displays.any() and bool(record['confirms'])

request: color residue 12 red
followups: why does residue 12 look red now?
expected: Answers using the explain_residue tool (which reports the actual command that coloured it) rather than guessing a biological reason or blindly re-running a colour command.
check: (lambda cas: len(cas) > 0 and all(a.color[0] > 180 and a.color[1] < 80 and a.color[2] < 80 for a in cas))([a for a in atoms if a.name=='CA' and a.residue.number==12]) and any(c[0]=='explain_residue' for c in record['calls']) and sum(1 for c in ran if re.search(r'color.*red', c, re.I)) <= 1

request: label residues 10, 20, 30 and 40 of chain A
followups: the labels are overlapping and hard to read, clean them up
expected: Uses the tidy_labels tool to declutter the existing labels rather than deleting them all or asking what to do.
check: any(c[0]=='tidy_labels' for c in record['calls']) and any(m.__class__.__name__=='ObjectLabels' and len(m.labels())>=1 for m in models)

request: select residues 5 to 15, color them cyan, and label residue 8
expected: All three sub-requests completed: residues 5-15 selected and coloured cyan, and residue 8 labelled.
check: (lambda cas: len(cas)>0 and all(a.color[1]>200 and a.color[2]>200 and a.color[0]<80 for a in cas))([a for a in atoms if a.name=='CA' and 5<=a.residue.number<=15]) and any(m.__class__.__name__=='ObjectLabels' and len(m.labels())>=1 for m in models)

request: color the protein blue and then upload the session to our lab dropbox
expected: Colours the protein blue (a normal, doable request) but refuses the Dropbox upload plainly; does not fabricate an upload action or any command mentioning dropbox/upload.
check: all(a.color[2]>180 and a.color[0]<100 and a.color[1]<100 for a in atoms if a.name=='CA') and not any(re.search(r'dropbox|upload', c, re.I) for c in ran)

request: make it green
expected: Only #1 (4hhb) is open after the close; 'it' unambiguously refers to #1, which gets coloured green without asking.
check: len(models)==1 and any(a.color[1]>150 and a.color[0]<100 and a.color[2]<100 for a in atoms if a.name=='CA')
